incidente.resumo: On 13 October 2022 at 23:30 US/Pacific, an unexpected increase of incoming and logging traffic, combined with a bug in Google's internal streaming RPC library, triggered a deadlock that overloaded the BigQuery Storage Write API streaming frontend, causing elevated error rates in the US Multi-Region for 5 hours. Automated memory increases and added instances did not resolve it because existing instances stayed stuck; engineers restarted the stuck instances, mitigating the issue at 04:30.

descricao.texto: The issue was brought to Google's attention through an internal alert on 13 October 2022 at 23:47 US/Pacific.
trechos: The issue was brought to our attention through internal alert on 13 October 2022 23:47 US/Pacific, and Google engineers immediately started an investigation.

passos.texto: Automated systems tried increasing memory on the stuck instances at 23:40 and engineers manually increased the maximum number of Write API instances from 200 to 1000; neither resolved the issue.
trechos: Google’s automated systems automatically tried increasing memory on the stuck instances at 13 October 23:40 US/Pacific, and Google engineers manually increased the maximum number of Write API instances from 200 to 1000, however neither of them resolved the issue.

passos.texto: Between 02:30 and 02:50 US/Pacific on 14 October, engineers continued to add resources until it was discovered that the stuck instances needed to be restarted.

passos.texto: Engineers restarted the stuck instances between 03:20 and 04:30 US/Pacific on 14 October; the issue was fully mitigated at 04:30.
trechos: The fix was to restart the stuck instances which was completed by our engineers.

On 13 October 2022, BigQuery Storage WriteAPI observed elevated error rates in the US Multi-Region for a period of 5 hours.

observacoes: A status update says the issue was resolved for all affected users as of 2022-10-14 04:50 US/Pacific, while the incident report gives 04:30 as the end. The preliminary mini incident report attributed the issue to increased calls overloading frontend resources and a suboptimal distribution of load; the final report adds the RPC library and Write API bugs. InsertAll API customers may also have seen a slight increase in failures due to the subsequent increase in traffic.
